Notes: 1. Ivory Properties and Hotels Private Limited (Registered owner) holds 104 Equity Shares for and on behalf of the beneficiaries of Ivory Property Trust (Promoter), out of its total shareholding of 35,71,533 Equity Shares.
2. The list of promoter group entities and individuals is provided on the basis of declarations/certifications received from the Promoters determined on the basis of the applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. The Company has made applications to the Stock Exchanges where the equity shares of the Company are listed viz. BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for re-classification of the following Promoter Group entities from 'Promoter Group' category to 'Public Shareholder' category, approval of which is under process with the Stock Exchanges:
a) Application 1 made on February 06, 2026: i. Sundew Real Estate Private Limited and, ii. Pramaan Properties Private Limited
b) Application 2 made on May 18, 2026: i. Content Properties Private Limited and, ii. Sycamore Properties Private Limited
3. As per Company's records, shareholding of Dr. Sanjay Sethi, Non-Executive Director is 2,34,015 Equity Shares as on June 30, 2026.
He had sold shares on June 30, 2026 which is not reflected in the beneficiary position as on June 30, 2026, as settlement is on T+1 basis.
Accordingly, the Shareholding Pattern being filed under Regulation 31 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 is being submitted as per the beneficiary position as on June 30, 2026 received from the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent of the Company.
